probes.name: fixed_array_parameter
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim target As Workbook, part As Object
Dim sourceText As String
Application.EnableEvents = False
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Set target = Workbooks.Add
sourceText = ""
Set part = target.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)
part.Name = "Helpers"
sourceText = sourceText & "Public Type FirstData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Value As Long" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Type" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Public Type SecondData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Value As Long" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Type" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Sub Change(ByRef item As FirstData)" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "item.Value = item.Value + 10" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Sub ChangeArray(ByRef items() As FirstData)" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "items(0).Value = items(0).Value + 10" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
part.CodeModule.AddFromString sourceText
sourceText = ""
Set part = target.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)
part.Name = "Caller"
sourceText = sourceText & "" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Function Check() As Long" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Dim items(0 To 1) As FirstData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "items(0).Value = 5" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Helpers.ChangeArray items" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Check = items(0).Value" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Function" & vbCrLf
part.CodeModule.AddFromString sourceText
Probe = CStr(Application.Run("'" & target.Name & "'!Caller.Check"))
target.Close False
End Function
